_doc: Base nodes: hologram meshes for the Command Center projector + prepared renders for the terminal screens. Units: metres (model scale), Z up, front = -Y, pivot = footprint centre on the ground. Built by blender/build_nodes.py. Module types: see blender/bn_kit.py.

ue._doc: UE content layout (mod plugin mount /FicsitAIHelper). Used by ue/ue_import_base_nodes.py and written into ue/base_nodes_table.json by the build.

display._doc: Hologram volume of the Command Center projector (art/command_center/blender/interior_model.py: emitter disc r 0.9 at floor + 0.96, scale ring r 1.17-1.2 at floor + 1.08, SOCKET_holo at floor + 2.05). Positions below are relative to SOCKET_holo, in metres.

single._doc: One node: mesh SM_Holo_<Node>_T<n> scaled to fit radius / max_height (per tier, see export/manifest.json -> scale_single).

multi._doc: 2-5 nodes: meshes SM_Holo_<Node>_T<n>_Mini, one common scale per layout = slot_radius / largest plate radius of all nodes and tiers, so relative sizes stay true. Slot 0 is the centre one for 5 (the hub). Slot positions are (x, y) from the socket axis; facing = same yaw as the single node.

central_hub.identity: persistent on every tier: front portal with >>> chevrons and steps, octagonal roof element, dish (front-left), antenna cluster (back-left), glowing plate outline

fluid_plant.identity: shared family: front portal with >>> and steps, light strips, glowing plate outline; own: process columns with slits, U pipe loops, tanks with the drop glyph, pipe runs; T2+: tank platform on a frame, fan block; T3: steel annex with stair and frame towers, light masts

logistics_hub.identity: shared family: front portal with >>>, corner pylons with light dots, light strips, plate outline, dish + antenna; own: hall with cut roof corners over a through conveyor (belts on legs out of both sides, chevrons pointing outwards), side tunnel frames; T2: side blocks, roll-up door, crate stacks; T3: two belts, fan block, roof crate storage, pipes

smelter.identity: shared family: portal frame, corner pylons with light dots, light strips, plate outline, through conveyor with side tunnel frames; own: furnace door with glowing heat lines instead of >>>, chimneys with wide collars (1/2/3 by tier), roof fan boxes; T2+: pipes down the walls; T3: side annex, ground fan box, pipe drops at the back

assembler.identity: shared family: hall with cut roof corners, through conveyor with side tunnel frames, corner pylons with light dots, light strips, plate outline; own: open front window bay with assembly robot arms (1/1/2), roof louvre box (T1) / roof fans (T2-T3); T2+: pipes down the walls; T3: tanks on the right, louvred panels at the back

refinery.identity: shared family: hall with cut roof corners, through conveyor, glow panel on the front, plate outline; own: hall runs along the belt (cut corners on the end faces), entry portal on the belt end with ORANGE warning lights, slim stepped stacks (1/2/2), banded tanks (1/2/2), pipe loops over the roof; T3: roof block with fans, orange safety railings, tank deck, steel tower with stair
refinery._doc: modelled with the belt along X and the entry portal on the -X end, then turned by tier.yaw = 90° so the portal faces the front (-Y) like the other nodes (concept view A)
